title: Do you have a job interview coming up? 🔎
description:
Here’s a tip if you have an upcoming job interview. If you’re unsure how to pronounce the name of the person you will be interviewing with head to their LinkedIn and look for a little speaker next to their name. This is an awesome LinkedIn feature where someone can record an audio bite of how their name is pronounced and it can be a great way for you to figure that out. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobinterview
